units.source_text: 那边点起灯笼，侍女们在叫：“夫人已经洗好头发，马上就出来了。”

en.t: Over there, lanterns were being lit, and the maids were calling, "The lady has finished washing her hair and will come out at once."

units.source_text: 除了坐起间之外，别处的格子窗已经一扇扇地在那里关了。

en.t: Except for the sitting room, the lattice shutters elsewhere had already been closed one by one.

units.source_text: 浮舟的房间离正屋稍远，本来是不住人的，所以室中放着一组高架橱，

en.t: Ukifune's room was a little removed from the main house and had not originally been lived in, so a set of high shelves stood inside,

units.source_text: 各处墙上靠着许多套在袋里的屏风，还有种种物件零乱地堆置着。

en.t: many bagged folding screens leaned against the walls here and there, and all sorts of other things were piled up in disorder.

units.source_text: 浮舟来住之后，这里便打开一面的纸隔扇，以便通向正屋。

en.t: After Ukifune came to live there, one paper sliding partition was opened so that the room could connect with the main house.

units.source_text: 大辅君的女儿名叫右近的，也在此地当侍女，

en.t: A daughter of Taifu no Kimi, named Ukon, was also serving there as a maid,

units.source_text: 此时她正在挨着次序关一扇扇格子窗，逐渐向这边靠近。

en.t: and at that moment she was closing the lattice shutters in order, one after another, gradually drawing nearer this way.

units.source_text: 她叫道：“呀，暗得很啊！这里还没有上灯呢！

en.t: She called out, "Oh, how dark it is! The lamps have not even been lit here yet!

units.source_text: 辛辛苦苦老早就把格子窗关上，暗得叫人发慌！”

en.t: After all the trouble of closing the shutters so early, it is dark enough to make one uneasy!"

units.source_text: 便重新把格子窗打开。

en.t: Then she opened the lattice shutters again.

units.source_text: 匂亲王听见了，稍感狼狈。

en.t: Prince Niou heard her and felt somewhat flustered.

units.source_text: 乳母更加着急，但她原是个精明干练而无所顾忌的人，

en.t: The nurse grew even more anxious, but she was by nature clever, capable, and unafraid of acting,

units.source_text: 便对右近说道：“喂喂，这里出了怪事，我弄得毫无办法，动手不得了！”

en.t: so she said to Ukon, "Listen, listen, something strange has happened here. I am completely at a loss and cannot do anything about it!"

units.source_text: 右近说：“什么事情呀？”

en.t: Ukon said, "What has happened?"

units.source_text: 便摸摸索索地走过来，看见一个穿衬衣的男子躺在浮舟身旁，

en.t: She came over, feeling her way in the dark, and saw a man in his underclothes lying beside Ukifune,

units.source_text: 又闻到浓烈的香气，便知道是匂亲王又做的好事。

en.t: and when she also smelled the powerful fragrance, she knew that Prince Niou had been at his mischief again.

units.source_text: 她推量浮舟是不会答应他的，便说道：“啊呀，这太不成样子了！

en.t: She guessed that Ukifune could never have consented to him, and said, "Oh dear, this is utterly improper!

units.source_text: 叫我右近说什么好呢？赶快到那边去，悄悄地把这事告诉夫人吧。”

en.t: What is this Ukon supposed to say? I will hurry over there and quietly tell the lady about this."

units.source_text: 说过就去了。

en.t: Having said that, she went off.

units.source_text: 这里的侍女都觉得把此事告诉夫人，太过分了。

en.t: The maids there all felt that telling the lady about this was going too far.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王满不在乎。

en.t: But Prince Niou was not the least bit concerned.

units.source_text: 他想：“这是一个令人吃惊的美人呢！不知到底是谁？

en.t: He thought, "She is an astonishing beauty. Who in the world can she be?

units.source_text: 从右近的口气听来，似乎不是一个新来的普通侍女。”

en.t: Judging from Ukon's tone, she does not seem to be an ordinary new maid."

units.source_text: 他莫名其妙，便问东问西，向浮舟缠绕不清。

en.t: Unable to make sense of it, he asked question after question and kept pestering Ukifune.

units.source_text: 浮舟不胜其苦，表面虽不表示愤怒之色，

en.t: Ukifune could hardly bear the torment, and although she showed no anger outwardly,

units.source_text: 但心中又是羞耻，又是懊恼，只想寻条死路。

en.t: inside she was filled with shame and distress, and wanted only to find a way to die.

units.source_text: 匂亲王便用软语温言抚慰她。

en.t: Prince Niou then tried to soothe her with gentle and tender words.
